thread:
sre_oncall: Heads-up — planned rolling rollout next Tue 2026-03-31 02:00-05:00 UTC for 'graceful-preempt' (preempt handling change) across Dedicated GPU pools. This includes a temporary SLO adjustment for p99 tail latency on dedicated routes and a synthetic 'traffic-shaping' loadtest immediately after to validate fallbacks.
maya: What's the scale? which regions / pools?
head_sre: West-2 and EU-North first wave, ~120 nodes total (3 GPU pools). We'll stagger by pool, 20m per pool, 15m buffer.
leo: Can we get the exact SLO delta we should expect so product teams can plan?
dana: p99 latency SLO for dedicated-route-tier drops from 200ms -> 350ms during the window; p50 unaffected. We'll annotate routes in console.
ops-bot: Calendar event created: "graceful-preempt rollout & synthetic loadtest" 2026-03-31 02:00-05:00 UTC. Invite: #eng-sre, #eng-platform. :calendar:
sre_oncall: Plan summary:
```
- Pre-checks: KV cache warmup, drain signals verified
- Rollout: stagger per pool (20m apply, 15m observe)
- Loadtest: synthetic traffic-generator hits canary routes at 0.5x -> 2x baseline over 60m
- Fallback: automatic revert to previous preempt handler on >2% error or >40% SLO burn
```
maya: How do we trigger the immediate rollback if things degrade?
leo: We have an automated policy in route controller. Manual rollback via:
```
kubectl -n redwood rollout undo deployment/route-controller --to-revision=3
```
sre_oncall: We'll also enable verbose tracing on affected routes for 3 hours post-rollout; logs will be forwarded to ephemeral trace index.
dana: Notifying customers on Dedicated plan requiring >24h notice? This is under the calendar event language; ops-bot already queued the banner.
head_sre: Notify support and account managers. We'll post a short incident-style summary after the test with metrics and any regressions. Use format: TL;DR, outcome, action items.
leo: I'll coordinate the synthetic load test script. tagging @maya to share the list of route IDs.
maya: Shared route IDs in the #eng-platform thread. Also added warmup traffic at T-10m.
sre_oncall: Final ask: if you observe any odd token-level cost spikes or KV cache pressure, ping oncall + escalate to #eng-sre-urgent. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Reminder: please ack the calendar event and update runbook checklist before EOD 2026-03-29.
head_sre: Acknowledged. We'll run a short smoke test one hour before the window.
leo: ack
maya: ack
sre_oncall: closing the thread here; will post a postmortem-ish summary after the run.
